root_cause: The matrix-independent advisory merged in #4809 accepted contradictory commit SHAs on two distinct matrix jobs belonging to the same workflow run attempt. Optional caller-provided minimum repetitions, minimum median and priority limit were not bounded at the mandatory evidence floor, enabling an advisory to be called from a weakened local configuration.

observed_evidence.provider_truth: GitHub Actions workflow run attempt is a single immutable commit scope; a sibling job's inconsistent SHA cannot be accepted as the same attempt

failed_approaches: Attempt to merge older #4808 matrix voter after #4809 already live; retired to avoid overwriting canonical owner
Treat optional minRepeatedRuns=1 or minMedianMs=0 as authority to bypass established statistical evidence threshold
Rank mixed-commit samples from the same run attempt despite a conflicting recorded head SHA
fix: Extend only existing read-only ci-agent-priorities.mjs with run+attempt SHA consistency validation; clamp repeated-run floor >=3, median execution floor >=60000ms, and priority count 1..5. Keep #4809's one-vote-per-workflow-attempt matrix logic and existing Janitor/Brain scheduler unchanged.
prevention_rule: If provider job evidence claims conflicting HEAD SHAs for one immutable run+attempt, fail closed without ranking. Caller options may make advisory stricter but may not loosen the statistical minimum or output cap. Advisory remains non-authoritative read-only guidance; never mutate PRs, dispatch CI, promote unverified build/portal changes or fabricate independent customer outcomes.

invariants: all matrix rows from one GitHub run+attempt have identical 40-character commit identity
never lower >=3 independent attempts, >=60000ms median, or <=5 advisory priorities by caller options
retain matrix-independent one vote per attempt from #4809
no new workflow or scheduler, no extra provider API reads
partial provider read cannot become an authorized optimization
exact-head Required/CodeQL and independent main + Janitor readback before live claim

terminal_rule: Exact-head hygiene, Required, CodeQL, protected merge, current-main source parity, skill projection, and real subsequent Janitor run; no claim of improved CI p95 or customer results without comparisons.
